body: RECALL VERIFIED SKIP: no candidate and no shared edit. RecallGraphUnforgeableSuite already has real runtime dependencies through RecallSegmenter.segment, RecallGraph.validated, equality/hash checks, copy, and validation of the edited graph. Baseline focused court passed 5/5 in standalone clone at e584ad6. Literal RecallGraph class -> case class is not a valid receipt here: production compilation stops first because the intentional witness-losing copy and generated copy both have defaults. After restore, I used the narrower compilable case-product-equivalent scratch mutation: make RecallGraph a Product and publicly open apply/fromProduct. With no test edit/clean, Zinc recompiled the suite and exactly its two construction/Product court tests failed (3/5); restoring production without clean returned 5/5 and the clone is clean. This proves the existing court is genuinely attached while preserving the reason the ordinary case-class mutation is impossible.
